**`RecordDetailView.tsx`, `panel-toggles.tsx`, `workspacePreference.ts` (Target 4).** ⊟ is one icon-only toggle (`h-8 w-8`, `aria-label` = 「右栏」, tooltip with `⌘⇧,`), pushed only when `pageColumns && pageHasRightColumn && (timeline.length > 0 || related.length > 0)`; `drawnPanelSwitch` gates the chord so it never flips a switch the reader cannot see; `⌘⇧.` and `PANEL_CHORD_KEYS['.']` are gone; `RECORD_TIMELINE_COLUMN_PREFERENCE` is deleted and `RECORD_RELATED_COLUMN_PREFERENCE` keeps its stored name. Tried to break it — **must-fix (④-1): the ⌘⇧, chord leaks across faces into another record's stored preference.** The listener is `document.addEventListener('keydown', …)`, installed by every mounted `RecordDetailView` whose tier has a right column. On `main` the embedded view was always `'tabs'`, so at most one view listened: the page's. This PR makes the embedded view take the width rule, and a record page is the host of the drawer its related rows and lookups open over it (`RecordPageDrawerHost` renders `{pageTree}` as its children with the drawer — a Radix `Sheet` — above; both views stay mounted). The drawer opens at `min(92vw, 720px)` (`overlayWidthFor('md', …)`, the stack), but it is a wider pane once the reader drags its handle (`storageKey`, remembered per object, up to `DRAWER_MAX_VW` = 60 vw — 864 px at 1440) or when the object's own overlay size is larger; at ≥ 760 px the drawer's view has a right column, draws its own ⊟ and installs its own listener. A modal Sheet hides the page from pointer and accessibility, not from document key events. So one ⌘⇧, in the drawer runs both handlers: the drawer's flips its object's switch (visible), and the page's flips `record.columns.related` for the PAGE's object (invisible, and stored). The reader closes the drawer and the page's right column is gone — for that object, until they find ⊟ again; for the same object on both faces, the two writes race on one key. Target 4 puts ⊟ on each face for that face's column; a chord that also rewrites another record's stored choice is a leak across records of exactly the kind this review is asked to find. Fix, small: let only the topmost record view own the chord — the page host knows a drawer is open (`RecordPageDrawerHost`'s `root !== null`, or the view's root `pageRootEl` having an open `[role="dialog"] [data-record-page-root]` above it in the document) and yields while it is; and pin "⌘⇧, in a 1000 px drawer over a 1440 px page flips the drawer's switch alone". `useAdvertiseShortcut` is unaffected (one row per id however many holders).

The split pane and the overlay drawer are a Radix `Sheet` (`SheetContent`, `role="dialog"`), so inside a pane the guard always finds the pane itself and the face never closes on Esc; the Sheet's `onEscapeKeyDown` → `handleEscape` then pops a level or closes the pane, and the reader who pressed Esc to leave the 动态 tab loses the record instead. The pane's enlarged faces (the 动态 tab, a related list's whole face) are reachable only since this PR. ‹ still returns, so this is not a dead end.
